parties.respondent: State Rep. By Inspector Of Police

summary: POCSO Act Section 6 conviction upheld; age determination methodology under POCSO Act Section 34 and JJ Act Section 94; ossification test vs school records; voluntary elopement testimony vs prosecution claim; consent irrelevant for statutory offense; Section 366 IPC acquittal consistent with finding of no abduction; life sentence reduced to 10 years.
legal_provisions_cited: Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012 s.6, s.17
final_judgment: Appeal partly allowed; POCSO Act conviction upheld but sentence reduced from life imprisonment to 10 years; Section 366 IPC acquittal confirmed; other convicts' sentences under Child Marriage Prohibition Act maintained.
